result.title: Branch Caching After Step Distillation in Four- and Eight-Step Image Generators
result.summary: Can a distilled image generator save time by reusing features between its few remaining denoising steps? We study a fixed branch cache that replaces selected attention and MLP evaluations while preserving the student's noise schedule. One full trajectory and one raw-cache trajectory from the same initial noise supply a scalar correction for each branch type and reuse position. At $1024^2$, one internal reuse reduces four-step Qwen-Image-Lightning denoising time from 1.279 to 0.977 seconds. Three reuses yield $1.51\times$ speedup on eight-step Lightning and $1.53\times$ on eight-step Hyper-FLUX. We evaluate image quality on all 200 DrawBench prompts. With the reuse positions held fixed, correction improves mean same-seed image fidelity over raw reuse by 0.66 and 0.87 dB on the two Lightning students. On Hyper-FLUX the PSNR difference is 0.01 dB, while LPIPS improves from 0.1625 to 0.1546. These results measure the effect of branch caching and correction while retaining each student's original sampling grid.

AI.brief_summary: 研究少步蒸馏扩散生成器中跨去噪步骤复用 attention 与 MLP 评估的固定分支缓存，并用同一初始噪声下完整轨迹与缓存轨迹的差值给出按分支类型和复用位置标定的标量校正，在 Qwen-Image-Lightning 与 Hyper-FLUX 上报告加速比与图像保真度。
AI.relevance_reason: 「复用陈旧中间状态 + 用参考轨迹校正误差」的思路可能可供核查多步 latent 推理中的状态缓存与计算节省，但其对象是图像生成质量而非推理证据使用，迁移性尚待判断。
